name: MAMy Expert
summary: This EA uses moving average-based signals to identify and follow market trends, opening positions when price crosses or confirms direction relative to one or more moving averages. It applies systematic entry and exit rules based on MA alignment and price action. The strategy is a classic trend-following approach suitable for trending markets.
summary_zh: 该EA基于移动平均线信号识别并跟随市场趋势，当价格与一条或多条均线发生交叉或确认方向时开仓。它应用基于均线排列和价格行为的系统性入场与出场规则。该策略是经典的趋势跟踪方法，适用于趋势明显的市场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用移动平均线判断市场趋势方向，当短期均线与长期均线形成金叉时做多，死叉时做空，属于经典的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件依赖于均线交叉信号以及价格相对于均线的位置确认，确保在趋势确立后才进场。出场条件通常包括反向交叉信号或固定的止盈止损水平，部分变体可能加入追踪止损来保护利润。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式，但具体参数取决于用户设置。资金管理上，止盈止损比例是风险控制的关键，缺乏动态仓位调整和资金管理算法可能是其短板。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses moving averages to determine market trend direction, going long on a golden cross and short on a death cross, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions rely on MA crossover signals and price position confirmation relative to the averages, ensuring positions are opened only after a trend is established. Exit conditions typically include opposite crossover signals or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with some variants adding trailing stops to protect profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or equity-proportional calculation, depending on user-configured parameters. Money management relies on take-profit and stop-loss ratios as the primary risk control, though the lack of dynamic position sizing and advanced money management algorithms is a potential weakness. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.name: MA_Applied_Price
parameters.description: 移动平均线应用价格类型

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和优化参数
趋势行情中表现良好，能捕捉较大趋势波段
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境灵活配置
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize parameters
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing significant trend moves
Highly configurable parameters allow users to adapt to different instruments and market conditions
cons: 震荡市场中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理算法
单一指标依赖使得策略适应性有限，无法应对复杂市场环境
cons_en: Frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets
Lacks dynamic position sizing and advanced money management algorithms
Reliance on a single indicator type limits strategy adaptability to complex market conditions
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标如ADX或ATR，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
引入动态仓位管理模块，根据账户资金和波动率自动调整仓位大小
improvements_en: Add trend filter indicators such as ADX or ATR to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing module that automatically adjusts lot size based on account equity and volatility

risk_points: 震荡市中均线交叉频繁产生虚假信号可能导致连续止损
缺乏最大回撤控制和每日亏损限制等资金保护机制
固定手数模式在高杠杆下可能导致单笔风险过大
risk_points_en: Frequent MA crossovers in ranging markets can generate false signals leading to consecutive stop-losses
Lacks drawdown control and daily loss limits as capital protection mechanisms
Fixed lot sizing mode may cause excessive per-trade risk under high leverage
